title: TrustyAI Explainability Toolkit
reasoning: The paper acknowledges the ethical implications and motivations for explainable AI (e.g., impact on human lives, fairness, trust) in its introduction and discussion of actionability. However, its primary focus is on the technical evaluation and benchmarking of explainability methods (LIME, SHAP, counterfactuals) based on metrics like faithfulness, monotonicity, impact score, stability, proximity, sparsity, and computational runtime. It does not contain sections dedicated to evaluating or benchmarking religion, morals, or ethics as core components of its contribution.
